body:
Operator-requested rename, ALL FOUR plugin packages, for memorability. TWO are already published on npm (@adlc/pi-package, @adlc/opencode-package @ 1.2.1) — this ticket does NOT publish or deprecate anything itself (that happens after merge, as part of the next release + a separate npm deprecate step); it makes every in-repo reference consistent with the new names so the NEXT release publishes correctly under them.

=== VERIFIED FULL REFERENCE INVENTORY (grep -rln across the repo, categorized) ===

FUNCTIONAL / LIVE CODE — must change, gets this wrong and real installs break:
1. plugins/adlc-pi/package.json — "name": "@adlc/pi-package" -> "@adlc/pi"
2. plugins/adlc-opencode/package.json — "name": "@adlc/opencode-package" -> "@adlc/opencode"
3. plugins/adlc-cursor/package.json — "name": "@adlc/cursor-package" -> "@adlc/cursor"
4. plugins/adlc-antigravity/package.json — "name": "@adlc/antigravity-package" -> "@adlc/antigravity"
5. plugins/adlc-opencode/lib/scaffold.mjs:60 — `export const PLUGIN_PKG_NAME = '@adlc/opencode-package';` — THIS IS THE STRING WRITTEN INTO A REAL USER'S .opencode/opencode.json "plugin" ARRAY during bootstrap. Getting this wrong means opencode tries to resolve a package that will never exist under the old name. Change to '@adlc/opencode'.
6. plugins/adlc-cursor/hooks.json (lines with "./node_modules/@adlc/cursor-package/hooks/...") — this file ships in the package (declared in package.json's "files" and "cursor.hooks" manifest field) and is a template/reference hooks.json; update the embedded paths to @adlc/cursor.
7. plugins/adlc-opencode/command/adlc-init.md and plugins/adlc-cursor/command/adlc-init.md — each contains a live `require.resolve('@adlc/<old-name>/package.json')` invocation used by the /adlc-init command to detect an npm install. Update both.
8. plugins/adlc-opencode/bin/cli.mjs — comments describing `npx @adlc/opencode-package init` usage; update for accuracy (not executed code, but shown to users via --help).

TESTS — must change to match the new production behavior (some hardcode literals, some exercise the real default):
9. plugins/adlc-opencode/test/scaffold.test.mjs — MANY hardcoded '@adlc/opencode-package' string literals (both exercising the true production default via ensurePluginRegistered(root) with no override — e.g. lines ~55-58, ~67-69 — and separately as explicit override arguments in later tests). Update ALL of them to '@adlc/opencode'. Read plugins/adlc-opencode/lib/scaffold.mjs's ensurePluginRegistered/pluginEntryFor/isOwnPluginEntry (they default their pkgName param to PLUGIN_PKG_NAME) to understand which test calls exercise the real default vs pass an explicit override — both categories should still use the new name post-rename (nothing should reference the retired name anymore, including test fixtures), EXCEPT deliberately-adversarial fixtures testing basename-matching against an arbitrary unrelated string (e.g. a test around line ~384 using a bare local path '/work/opencode-package' to test basename-claim replacement logic) — READ that test's actual assertion intent before touching it; if it's testing generic basename matching against ANY string (not specifically the retired package name), it may be fine to leave as an arbitrary fixture string that no longer collides with the real name, OR could be updated to '/work/opencode' for consistency — use judgment, but do not break the test's actual intent.
10. plugins/adlc-opencode/test/plugin-options.test.mjs:2 — a comment describing the options tuple shape referencing the old name; cosmetic, update.
11. plugins/adlc-pi/test/packaging.test.mjs, plugins/adlc-cursor/test/packaging.test.mjs, plugins/adlc-antigravity/test/packaging.test.mjs — re-verify (npm pack --dry-run) still passes after the package.json name field changes; none of these currently hardcode the OLD name in an assertion (verified: no 'pkg.name ===' assertions exist), but re-run them to be sure nothing else broke.
12. scripts/cursor-install-smoke.mjs:28 and scripts/opencode-install-smoke.mjs:26 — each asserts `pkg.name !== '@adlc/<old>-package'` as a FAIL condition; update both to check for the new short name instead.
13. scripts/opencode-install-smoke.mjs (T30 section, ~lines 265-282) — three more '@adlc/opencode-package' references in the publishability/bootstrap smoke checks; update all.
14. scripts/test/release.test.mjs — fixture data using '@adlc/pi-package' and '@adlc/opencode-package' as EXAMPLE plugin package names to test release.mjs's generic (name-agnostic) lockstep-bump logic. release.mjs itself matches on the '@adlc/' PREFIX of dependency keys, not exact package identity, so these fixtures are not load-bearing for correctness — but update them anyway for consistency/accuracy (they read as stale documentation otherwise). Do not change release.mjs's actual matching LOGIC (prefix-based, name-agnostic — this is correct and must not change).

DOCS (current, user-facing — must change for accuracy):
15. docs/integrations/{pi,opencode,cursor,antigravity}.md — every occurrence of the old package names in prose and install commands.
16. apps/docs/content/docs/integrations/{pi,opencode,cursor,antigravity}.mdx — same, independently maintained from the .md files per established precedent (see T29's docs-truth-v2 pass, which updated both).
17. apps/docs/lib/integration-facts.mjs — powers the docs-site marketing/integrations page (apps/docs/test/integration-facts.test.mjs cross-checks its slugs against apps/docs/content/docs/integrations/*.mdx filenames and docs/integrations/*.md existence — do not change the 'slug' fields, only the 'note'/'install' string CONTENT). This file is ALSO currently STALE independent of the rename: it still says pi/opencode are "not on npm yet" / no formal install guide, even though both were ALREADY PUBLISHED earlier in this session (as @adlc/pi-package@1.2.1 / @adlc/opencode-package@1.2.1) — bring pi and opencode's notes/install arrays up to date with BOTH the rename AND their actual published state (mirror the real install commands already documented in docs/integrations/pi.md and docs/integrations/opencode.md — 'npm install -g @adlc/cli' + the harness-native install verb). cursor/antigravity remain accurately "not on npm yet" (still true after this ticket — it doesn't publish).
18. .claude/commands/release.md:17 — one example reference '@adlc/pi-package' in prose describing what scripts/release.mjs bumps; update to '@adlc/pi' for accuracy. This is a Claude Code slash-command definition file, safe to edit (not a rail anywhere in this repo's history).
19. scripts/release.mjs — TWO comments (line ~51 describing the historical T30 stranding incident by the OLD name, line ~168 giving '@adlc/pi-package' as an illustrative example) — update the illustrative example only; the line ~51 comment describes a HISTORICAL INCIDENT ("...is exactly how @adlc/opencode-package ended up registered...") — you may update the package-name mention there too since it's describing the same conceptual incident just with updated terminology, this is not rewriting a ticket/ADR historical record, it's a source-code comment about a mechanism.

DO NOT TOUCH (historical/archival — point-in-time record, this repo's established convention is to never retroactively rewrite these):
- .adlc/tickets.json — every existing ticket's "body" text (T29, T30, T37, etc. reference the old names as historical fact — they described what was true when authored; do not edit any EXISTING ticket's body/title. This ticket (T38) is itself the only new entry.)
- .adlc/specs/cursor-native-parity.md
- docs/adr/0004-adlc-opencode-integration.md
- docs/marketing/2026-07-05-adlc-marketing-site-plan.md
- docs/opencode-integration-plan.md
- docs/specs/opencode-integration-continuation.md
- docs/specs/opencode-native-flush.md
- docs/specs/pi-native-flush.md
- docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-01-adlc-antigravity-integration.md

=== VERIFICATION METHOD FOR THE FULL SET ===
After all edits: `grep -rln "@adlc/pi-package\|@adlc/opencode-package\|@adlc/cursor-package\|@adlc/antigravity-package" --include="*.md" --include="*.mdx" --include="*.mjs" --include="*.json" --include="*.ts" --include="*.yml" .` (excluding node_modules/.git) must return ONLY the "DO NOT TOUCH" historical files listed above — nothing else. Run this exact grep and manually confirm every remaining hit is on the do-not-touch list.

=== ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA ===
- AC1: all four package.json "name" fields are the short form. VERIFY: node -e checks for all four.
- AC2: plugins/adlc-opencode/lib/scaffold.mjs's PLUGIN_PKG_NAME constant equals '@adlc/opencode'; a fresh ensurePluginRegistered(root) call (no override) registers '@adlc/opencode' into a target opencode.json. VERIFY: node --test plugins/adlc-opencode/test/scaffold.test.mjs green, plus a NEW or existing test explicitly asserting the constant's value.
- AC3: plugins/adlc-cursor/hooks.json contains no reference to the retired name. VERIFY: grep.
- AC4: both command/adlc-init.md files' require.resolve() calls reference the new short names. VERIFY: grep.
- AC5: scripts/cursor-install-smoke.mjs and scripts/opencode-install-smoke.mjs both pass when run against this branch's packages (node scripts/cursor-install-smoke.mjs . and node scripts/opencode-install-smoke.mjs . both exit 0) and their internal assertions check for the NEW names (grep confirms old-name assertions are gone).
- AC6: the full grep from "VERIFICATION METHOD" above returns ONLY do-not-touch files — paste the actual grep output in your build report.
- AC7: apps/docs/test/integration-facts.test.mjs still passes (slugs/structure unchanged, only note/install string content updated); pi and opencode's entries in integration-facts.mjs accurately reflect BOTH the new short name AND their already-published state (no longer say "not on npm yet").
- AC8: full root `npm test` exits 0.
- AC9: no version bump (package.json "version" fields untouched by this ticket — that happens in the NEXT release cycle after this merges), no tag, no publish, no npm deprecate command run.

Suppressions are denied; marker fixtures (if any test needs a suppression-marker-shaped string) must be assembled by concatenation, mirroring the established convention. This ticket touches plugins/adlc-pi/**, plugins/adlc-opencode/**, plugins/adlc-cursor/**, and plugins/adlc-antigravity/** simultaneously — all previously-frozen rails from completed tickets (T29/T30/T37), now auto-expired per T36's rails-completion-lifecycle since those tickets are completed:true on main. Declaring packages/**, .github/workflows/**, and docs/ci/** as rails below since this ticket has no legitimate reason to touch them.
title: Rename the four plugin packages to short harness names (@adlc/{pi,opencode,cursor,antigravity}-package → @adlc/{pi,opencode,cursor,antigravity})
